title: Veken Innovation Award Winner Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain, 108oz, C1
say: Customers report that their cats and dogs love this water fountain, appreciating its super quiet operation and easy-to-clean stainless steel design. Moreover, the fountain is easy to assemble and use, with one customer noting it takes just minutes to disassemble. Additionally, they like its appearance, particularly the sage green color that matches dining room decor, and its capacity, with cats drinking triple the usual amount. However, the pump durability receives mixed reviews, with several customers reporting it stopped working after 45 days of use.
